CustomField.description: When non-null, the Hours without approval card is hidden from the Delivery Hub app Home page. Null = shown (default). Inverted-name field (Hide, not Show) so the safe posture is the default null state, mirroring the home-visibility convention. The card also stays hidden while EnableUnapprovedHoursFlagDateTime__c is null.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set to a date/time to hide the Hours without approval card on the Home page. Leave blank to show it.
CustomField.label: Hide Home Unapproved Hours
